clue.text: It produces fruit or veg

parts.note: chard is a leafy vegetable, short for Swiss chard

explanation.surface: A gardener's question of whether a plot is for fruit or for vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' looks like a link between 'fruit' and 'veg', but it is taken as written.
explanation.definitionFit: A plantation of fruit trees is what yields apples, pears and plums.

clue.text: Become aware that lies are untrue

indicators.note: untrue suggests the letters are not set out properly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone coming to see that certain lies are false.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to understand or notice a fact is a synonym of grasping it.

clue.text: Landlord accommodates student composer

indicators.note: a landlord accommodating a lodger takes it inside, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a host is a landlord of an inn
L is a learner, the student driver's plate

explanation.surface: A landlord giving lodgings to a music student.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the learner plate British student drivers display.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst was an English composer, best known for The Planets.

clue.text: Good opinion of physical training college during recess

indicators.note: the training and college happen within the recess, so they sit inside it

parts.note: a rest is a recess or break
PE is physical education, school physical training

explanation.surface: A favourable view of a sports college, reached during a break.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteem or high regard for a person, as in holding someone in esteem.

clue.text: Go off in posh car for the river

indicators.note: the bang of going off is placed in the middle of the car word

parts.note: a limo is a limousine, a luxury car
to pop is to go off with a bang

explanation.surface: Someone told to drive off in a limousine to visit the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Limpopo is a major river in southern Africa, famous from Kipling's Just So Stories.

clue.text: Harm one married couple

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: Someone damaging the relationship of a married couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To weaken or damage, a synonym for injuring something.

clue.text: Writer gets sample for versifier

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American writer
a taster is a small sample

explanation.surface: An author receiving a sample of a poet's work.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetaster is a poor or would-be poet, a scorned rhymester.

clue.text: Crumpet found in fish bar

parts.note: the pike is a freshwater fish
a let is an obstruction or bar, as in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: A crumpet turning up in a fish and chip bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A crumpet is a British griddle cake; a pikelet is a thin regional crumpet.
explanation.definitionFit: A pikelet is a thin griddle cake, a regional name for a type of crumpet.

clue.text: Dicky hadn't any space for the second-rate

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for unsound or shaky, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone called Dicky had no room left for inferior goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a name, but it is the British word for unsound.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for shoddy goods that are low in price and poor in quality.

clue.text: Tory leader has pain in bum

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, here of Tory

parts.note: to ail is to pain or trouble someone

explanation.surface: A Conservative party leader suffering a painful backside.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words can name the rear end, the backside of a person or animal.

clue.text: Dog for lively king in Kent?

indicators.note: the lively king are placed in the middle of the region's abbreviation

parts.note: Kent is an English county in the South East, abbreviated SE; the question mark flags the example
chipper means cheerful and lively
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Looking for a dog to suit a sprightly monarch living in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in south-east England, so it stands for SE by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A schipperke is a small black Belgian breed, once kept on barges.

clue.text: Cancel raise

definitions.meaning: to ... a ban or restriction is to cancel it
to ... something is to raise it up

explanation.surface: An instruction to call off a price rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Removing a ban and hoisting a load both use this verb.

clue.text: In the morning one guy is good-natured

parts.note: AM is ante meridiem, before noon
I is the Roman numeral for one
a guy is a rope or cable steadying a tent or mast

explanation.surface: A fellow who is cheerful first thing in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' suggests a man, but it is the guy rope.
explanation.definitionFit: Friendly and peaceable in manner, as in an agreeable settlement.

clue.text: Crumbling path rated a highly dangerous place to be

definitions.text: a highly dangerous place to be

indicators.note: crumbling means falling apart, so these letters break up and reform

explanation.surface: A crumbling footpath is judged a hazard to walkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically, any structure or spot likely to cause death or injury.

clue.text: Slim and winning but too late to keep one's hair on

definitions.text: too late to keep one's hair on

parts.note: slim means thin
a side that is winning is on top

explanation.surface: Someone lean and successful but already going bald.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keep one's hair on' is the idiom for staying calm, but here it is taken literally: a balding person cannot keep hair on.
explanation.definitionFit: Going bald, an idiom for losing hair on the crown of the head.

clue.text: Condition of the country

definitions.meaning: a condition, as in a sorry situation or shape
a nation, as in a sovereign country

explanation.surface: A report on how the nation is faring.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a condition and a nation with its own government.

clue.text: One sinks into seat? That's capital!

indicators.note: the single letter is pushed deep within the seat word

parts.note: a sofa is a seat
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone sinking into a comfortable couch and pronouncing it excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like an exclamation of approval, but it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Sofia is the capital city of Bulgaria.

clue.text: Continued good luck when riding a cycle

parts.note: riding a bike means being on it
a roll is one turning cycle of a wheel

explanation.surface: A lucky streak that comes while out cycling.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for a run of success that keeps going.

clue.text: Predict a stupid charge

parts.note: dumb means stupid
a rate is a charge, as in a fee

explanation.surface: A forecast of a foolish fee.
explanation.definitionFit: To foreshadow, giving a faint indication of something to come.

clue.text: Girl touring US city gets disease

indicators.note: the girl goes all around the city, so it sits within her name

parts.note: Maria is a girl's name
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A girl on a trip around an American city falls ill.
explanation.definitionFit: A mosquito-borne fever caused by a parasite, an infectious illness.

clue.text: Kitty supports shy drunkard

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting piece sits beneath, so the kitty comes last

parts.note: to shy is to throw or toss
a kitty is a pot of pooled money

explanation.surface: A cat looking after a timid alcoholic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kitty' and 'shy' look like a cat and timidity, but they are a fund and a throw.
explanation.definitionFit: A tosspot is an old word for a habitual heavy drinker.

clue.text: Jail a lawyer in North America

definitions.note: the definition is a place found in North America, a country there

parts.note: can is slang for jail
a DA is a district attorney, a US lawyer

explanation.surface: An American lawyer being sent to prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Canada is the large country occupying the north of that continent.

clue.text: Prospect for gold in the country

indicators.note: the gold is placed inside the country's name

parts.note: Panama is a Central American country
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A miner prospecting for gold somewhere in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prospect for gold' looks like a single phrase about mining, but 'Prospect' is the definition, a view.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a wide view of a landscape, a sweeping vista.

clue.text: Closed rapidly

definitions.meaning: shut ... means shut tight, firmly closed

explanation.surface: A door that shut quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both firmly shut, as in stuck shut, and at high speed.

clue.text: Trees take time to become predominant

parts.note: firs are coniferous trees

explanation.surface: Trees taking years to grow until they dominate a wood.
explanation.definitionFit: Foremost or leading, ahead of the rest in importance.

clue.text: Undertaker is caught working farm machinery

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a machine that is on is working
a tractor pulls farm machinery

explanation.surface: A funeral director nabbed operating agricultural vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Undertaker' suggests a funeral director, but it means one who undertakes a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A builder or tradesperson who undertakes work under an agreement.

clue.text: Informer keeps president absorbed

indicators.note: the informer keeps the president within it, holding it inside

parts.note: a rat is an informer

explanation.surface: A spy holding a president enthralled.
explanation.definitionFit: Engrossed or wholly engaged in something, as an attentive audience is.

clue.text: Indiscretion needs a course of action in the shipyard

definitions.note: the definition is a thing found in a shipyard, a ramp for launching vessels

parts.note: a slip is a minor lapse or indiscretion
a way is a method or course of action

explanation.surface: A blunder at the docks requires a plan to fix it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloping ramp in a dockyard down which vessels are built and launched.

clue.text: Tory gets an informal farewell in musical form

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative, a Tory
ta-ta is a casual British goodbye

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician bidding a casual goodbye with a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantata is a sung composition for voices and instruments.
